title: Blog
subtitle: 「網誌／網上日誌」，這個詞本身已非常精準，因此不應為了數量而硬塞大量『同義詞』。
description: 「網誌／網上日誌」，這個詞本身已非常精準，因此不應為了數量而硬塞大量『同義詞』。

words.meaning: 網上日誌；網上期刊式網誌
words.example: She keeps an online journal about studying abroad.
words.exampleZh: 她寫了一個關於海外留學生活的網上日誌。

exercises.original: She writes a blog about her experiences studying overseas.
exercises.zh: 她寫網誌記錄海外留學經歷。
exercises.upgrade: She writes an online journal about her experiences studying overseas.

options.explanation: 內容是持續記錄個人留學經歷，日誌式 blog 最適合改寫成 online journal。
forum 以多人討論串為核心，不是單一作者持續發文。
留學個人經歷不是以新聞報道為主要形式。
單一網頁不能表達持續更新的整個網誌。
社交帳戶可能分享經歷，但平台形式和 blog 不同。
學術期刊經同行評審或正式出版，與個人留學網誌不同。

exercises.original: His travel blog contains dated entries from every country he visits.
exercises.zh: 他的旅遊網誌載有到訪每個國家的日期式文章。
exercises.upgrade: His online journal contains dated entries from every country he visits.

options.explanation: 太寬泛，任何類型網站都可叫 website。
dated entries + travel experiences 正是日誌式網誌特徵。
一個 page 無法涵蓋多篇 dated entries。

exercises.original: The artist uses her blog to record ideas and reflections on new work.
exercises.zh: 藝術家用網誌記錄新作品的想法和反思。
exercises.upgrade: The artist uses her online journal to record ideas and reflections on new work.

options.explanation: 可作較廣義描述，但個人 ideas/reflections 更接近 journal。
record ideas and reflections 是典型 journal 功能。
可能分享內容，但不等於 blog。

words.example: The researcher maintained a weblog documenting the project.
words.exampleZh: 研究員維護一個網誌，記錄該項目。

exercises.original: The researcher maintained a blog documenting the project from 2004 onward.
exercises.zh: 研究員自2004年起維護網誌，記錄項目進展。
exercises.upgrade: The researcher maintained a weblog documenting the project from 2004 onward.

options.explanation: 只是一個頁面，不能表達多年持續更新。
weblog 是 blog 的原始完整名稱，2004 年語境尤其自然。
不表示研究員自己的連續文章。
形式不同，且早期語境更不合。

exercises.original: Her technology blog attracted readers from around the world.
exercises.zh: 她的科技網誌吸引世界各地讀者。
exercises.upgrade: Her technology weblog attracted readers from around the world.

options.explanation: 科技論壇以討論為核心，不等於作者的網誌。
technology weblog 可直接保留 blog 的形式與主題。
單頁不足以表示整體網誌。
科技主題不代表是正式學術期刊。
可能有科技新聞，但不等同 blog。
作品集展示作品，不是持續發文網誌。

exercises.original: The company launched a blog for product-development updates.
exercises.zh: 公司開設網誌發布產品開發更新。
exercises.upgrade: The company launched a weblog for product-development updates.

options.explanation: 公司可能已有整個網站，但題目說的是專門持續更新的 blog。
更新由公司發布，不是使用者討論。
公司網誌的直接近義詞。
電子報通常經電郵／定期寄送，不是網誌頁面。

words.example: They created a web log to record progress on the expedition.
words.exampleZh: 他們建立網絡日誌，記錄探險進度。

exercises.original: They created a blog to record each stage of the expedition.
exercises.zh: 他們建立網誌記錄探險每個階段。
exercises.upgrade: They created a web log to record each stage of the expedition.

options.explanation: 作為公開網上記錄，透明地改寫 blog。
技術上是伺服器活動記錄，不是人撰寫的文章網誌。
不符作者主導的紀錄形式。

exercises.original: The class blog records weekly progress on the science project.
exercises.zh: 班級網誌記錄科學項目的每週進度。
exercises.upgrade: The class web log records weekly progress on the science project.

options.explanation: 太廣，沒有 weekly log 的特色。
weekly progress record 與 log 的語義完全吻合。
一個靜態頁面不能充分表達每週連續記錄。
不一定由班級統一發布進度。

exercises.original: The team kept a blog during the field study.
exercises.zh: 團隊在實地研究期間維持網上記錄。
exercises.upgrade: The team kept a web log during the field study.

options.explanation: kept a log during field study 很自然，表示持續記錄。

words.meaning: 網上日誌；網絡期刊式網誌
words.example: His web journal follows life in several remote communities.
words.exampleZh: 他的網上日誌記錄多個偏遠社區的生活。

exercises.original: His blog follows everyday life in a remote fishing community.
exercises.zh: 他的網誌記錄偏遠漁村的日常生活。
exercises.upgrade: His web journal follows everyday life in a remote fishing community.

options.explanation: follows everyday life 有長期日誌／紀錄性質。
不以單一作者的連續記錄為核心。
生活紀錄不等於新聞網站。

exercises.original: The photographer's blog combines short essays with weekly photo entries.
exercises.zh: 攝影師的網誌結合短文和每週相片記錄。
exercises.upgrade: The photographer's web journal combines short essays with weekly photo entries.

options.explanation: 也可，但 weekly entries 的日誌特色使 web journal 更精準。
short essays + weekly entries 很吻合。
作品集偏展示完成作品，不一定有定期文章／日誌。

exercises.original: She updates her blog every Sunday with reflections on teaching.
exercises.zh: 她每逢星期日更新網誌，分享教學反思。
exercises.upgrade: She updates her web journal every Sunday with reflections on teaching.

options.explanation: teaching reflection 不等於學術期刊。
regular reflections 是典型 journal-style blog。

words.example: The blog began as an online diary of her first year at university.
words.exampleZh: 這個網誌最初是她大學一年級生活的網上日記。

exercises.original: Her blog began as a record of daily life at university.
exercises.zh: 她的網誌最初是大學日常生活的記錄。
exercises.upgrade: Her online diary began as a record of daily life at university.

options.explanation: daily life + personal record 是日記型 blog 的核心特徵。
個人大學生活不是新聞網站。
完全不同的主體和用途。

exercises.original: He used the blog to write about his feelings during the year abroad.
exercises.zh: 他用網誌記錄海外一年期間的感受。
exercises.upgrade: He used the online diary to write about his feelings during the year abroad.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 feelings + personal year abroad 更私人，online diary 更精準。
明確以個人感受和生活經驗為核心。

exercises.original: The teenager's blog contains personal entries about school and friends.
exercises.zh: 這名青少年的網誌載有關於學校和朋友的私人文章。
exercises.upgrade: The teenager's online diary contains personal entries about school and friends.

options.explanation: 可以包含這些內容，但不一定是日記式。
personal entries about school and friends 是典型私人日記。

words.example: She started a personal blog about books and everyday life.
words.exampleZh: 她開設個人網誌，分享書籍和日常生活。

exercises.original: She runs a blog about books, food and everyday life.
exercises.zh: 她經營個人網誌，分享書籍、美食和日常生活。
exercises.upgrade: She runs a personal blog about books, food and everyday life.

options.explanation: books, food, everyday life 以個人興趣和經驗為核心。

exercises.original: His blog reflects his own opinions on travel and design.
exercises.zh: 他的網誌分享他本人對旅遊和設計的看法。
exercises.upgrade: His personal blog reflects his own opinions on travel and design.

options.explanation: 太正式，也可能由多人編輯。
his own opinions 是個人網誌的直接線索。
偏作品展示而不是意見文章。

exercises.original: The writer started a blog before publishing her first book.
exercises.zh: 作家在出版第一本書前開設個人網誌。
exercises.upgrade: The writer started a personal blog before publishing her first book.

options.explanation: 可能成立但太廣；題目明確說持續發文的 blog。
個人作者自主經營的網誌最自然。

words.example: The organisation launched a blog site for weekly updates.
words.exampleZh: 該機構推出網誌網站，每週發布更新。

exercises.original: The organisation launched a blog for weekly updates.
exercises.zh: 該機構推出網誌網站，每週發布更新。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation launched a blog site for weekly updates.

options.explanation: launch + weekly updates 表示建立整個網誌網站。
單篇文章不能承載持續每週更新。
發送式刊物，不是網站本身。
若只是機構更新，稱 news site 過強。

exercises.original: The museum's blog contains hundreds of articles in its archive.
exercises.zh: 博物館網誌網站的存檔內有數百篇文章。
exercises.upgrade: The museum's blog site contains hundreds of articles in its archive.

options.explanation: 雖然正確但過於寬泛，沒有指出文章式網誌結構。
hundreds of articles + archive 明確是整個網誌網站。
單篇文章不會包含數百篇文章存檔。
博物館文章網誌不等於學術期刊。

exercises.original: Readers can search the blog by topic and date.
exercises.zh: 讀者可以在網誌網站按主題和日期搜尋。
exercises.upgrade: Readers can search the blog site by topic and date.

options.explanation: 一篇文章通常不提供整站按日期搜尋。
topic/date archive 是網站層級功能。

words.meaning: 日誌式網站；期刊式網站
words.example: The project uses a journal-style website to publish weekly reflections.
words.exampleZh: 該項目使用日誌式網站發布每週反思。

exercises.original: The project blog publishes a dated reflection every Friday.
exercises.zh: 項目網誌每星期五發布一篇有日期的反思。
exercises.upgrade: The project uses a journal-style website that publishes a dated reflection every Friday.

options.explanation: dated reflection every Friday 正是日誌式網站結構。
不以固定作者的定期文章為核心。

exercises.original: The site functions as a blog with entries arranged by date.
exercises.zh: 該網站以網誌形式運作，文章按日期排列。
exercises.upgrade: The site functions as a journal-style website with entries arranged by date.

options.explanation: entries arranged by date 是最關鍵的形式線索。
不一定按日誌方式呈現。

exercises.original: Their blog records weekly lessons learned from the community project.
exercises.zh: 他們的網誌每週記錄社區項目的學習心得。
exercises.upgrade: Their journal-style website records weekly lessons learned from the community project.

options.explanation: 可作上位詞，但 weekly lessons learned 更具 journal 結構。
weekly reflective entries 完全吻合。

words.example: Her personal website contains essays, travel notes and regular updates.
words.exampleZh: 她的個人網站載有文章、旅遊札記和定期更新。

exercises.original: Her blog also contains a biography, portfolio and contact page.
exercises.zh: 她的個人網站除了網誌外，還有個人簡介、作品集和聯絡頁面。
exercises.upgrade: Her personal website also contains a biography, portfolio and contact page.

options.explanation: biography + portfolio + contact page 顯示範圍已超越純 blog。
單篇文章不會包含整個網站結構。

exercises.original: The author's blog serves as the main website for her work and profile.
exercises.zh: 作者的網誌同時作為展示作品和個人資料的主要網站。
exercises.upgrade: The author's personal website serves as the main site for her work and profile.

options.explanation: 只突出文章／日誌，不足以涵蓋 work and profile。
main site for work and profile 是個人網站功能。

exercises.original: His blog has grown to include a CV, project gallery and downloadable resources.
exercises.zh: 他的網誌已擴展，包含履歷、項目相簿和可下載資源。
exercises.upgrade: His personal website has grown to include a CV, project gallery and downloadable resources.

options.explanation: 單篇文章不可能代表 CV、gallery 和 resources 的整體網站。
多功能個人站點已超出純 blog。
通常不具完整網站資源架構。

words.example: The blog grew into an independent online publication with several writers.
words.exampleZh: 這個網誌發展成由多名作者撰稿的獨立網上刊物。

exercises.original: The blog now has several editors and publishes daily analysis.
exercises.zh: 這個網誌現有多名編輯，每天發布分析文章。
exercises.upgrade: The blog has grown into an online publication with several editors and daily analysis.

options.explanation: several editors + daily analysis 顯示已由個人 blog 發展成較正式網上刊物。
多名編輯和分析文章不具私人日記特徵。
不符正式編輯出版結構。

exercises.original: What began as a small blog now publishes work by ten writers.
exercises.zh: 最初的小網誌現在刊登十名作者的文章。
exercises.upgrade: What began as a small blog is now an online publication featuring work by ten writers.

options.explanation: 可以多人內容，但不突出編輯出版性。
ten writers + publishes work 是明顯出版物結構。
多人供稿不符合個人日記。

exercises.original: The specialist blog publishes long-form articles for professionals.
exercises.zh: 這個專業網誌為業界人士刊登長篇文章。
exercises.upgrade: The specialist blog functions as an online publication for professionals.

options.explanation: 專業讀者不代表是論壇。
長篇專業文章未必是新聞。
specialist + long-form + professional readership 很適合。

words.example: What began as a blog is now a specialist web publication.
words.exampleZh: 最初只是一個網誌，現在已成為專業網絡刊物。

exercises.original: The technology blog has become a professional publication on the web.
exercises.zh: 這個科技網誌已發展成專業網絡刊物。
exercises.upgrade: The technology blog has become a professional web publication.

options.explanation: professional + web-distributed articles 直接符合。
專業科技內容不是私人日記。

exercises.original: The blog publishes specialist reviews and essays every week.
exercises.zh: 這個網誌每週刊登專業評論和文章。
exercises.upgrade: The web publication publishes specialist reviews and essays every week.

options.explanation: specialist reviews and essays 是網絡刊物形式。

exercises.original: The former hobby blog now employs editors and freelance writers.
exercises.zh: 昔日的興趣網誌現已聘用編輯和自由撰稿人。
exercises.upgrade: The former hobby blog is now a web publication employing editors and freelance writers.

options.explanation: 無法充分表達編輯與撰稿團隊的出版結構。
editors + freelance writers 是成熟網絡刊物特徵。

words.meaning: 數碼日誌；電子期刊式刊物
words.example: The site functions as a digital journal for the design team.
words.exampleZh: 該網站作為設計團隊的數碼日誌。

exercises.original: The design team's blog records long-form reflections after each project.
exercises.zh: 設計團隊的網誌在每個項目後記錄長篇反思。
exercises.upgrade: The design team's digital journal records long-form reflections after each project.

options.explanation: long-form reflections + repeated project record 很適合數碼日誌。
通常較短且平台結構不同。
專業團隊反思不等於學術期刊。

exercises.original: The research blog contains dated field notes and reflective entries.
exercises.zh: 研究網誌包含有日期的實地筆記和反思文章。
exercises.upgrade: The digital journal contains dated field notes and reflective entries.

options.explanation: 也可，但 field notes + reflective entries 更具有 journal 性質。
dated notes 和 reflections 是核心線索。

exercises.original: The site operates as a blog where staff document lessons from each case.
exercises.zh: 該網站以網誌形式運作，員工記錄每個個案的經驗教訓。
exercises.upgrade: The site operates as a digital journal where staff document lessons from each case.

options.explanation: 太寬，沒有突出持續紀錄功能。
document lessons from each case 顯示連續的專業日誌。

falseSynonyms.zh: 網誌文章不等於整個 blog blog post 是網誌中的單篇文章；blog 是整個網誌／網站或持續發布的內容集合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A blog contains blog posts; one post is not the whole blog.

falseSynonyms.zh: 網站過於寬泛 website 可以是商店、銀行、學校、搜尋器或任何網站；blog 只是其中一種網站／內容形式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every blog may be hosted on a website, but most websites are not blogs.

falseSynonyms.zh: 個人網站不一定是 blog personal website 可包含履歷、作品集、聯絡資料或相簿；只有以定期文章為主時才和 blog 接近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A personal website may contain a blog without itself being primarily a blog.

falseSynonyms.zh: 論壇不等於網誌 forum 以多名使用者討論串和回覆為核心；blog 通常由一名或少數作者發布主要文章。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A forum is discussion-led; a blog is usually post-led.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社交媒體帳戶不等於 blog 社交媒體可以發布短文和更新，但其平台結構、追蹤機制和內容形式不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A social-media account may share posts, but it is not normally called a blog.

falseSynonyms.zh: 新聞網站不等於 blog news site 主要發布新聞報道；blog 可以評論、記錄或分享專門內容。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A news site may host blogs, but the whole news site is not necessarily a blog.

falseSynonyms.zh: journal 有多個意思 journal 可以是私人日記，也可以是正式學術期刊；只有特定語境才接近 blog。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An academic journal is a scholarly publication, not simply a blog.

falseSynonyms.zh: 網頁不等於網誌 web page 是網站中的單一頁面；blog 通常由多篇文章和頁面組成。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A web page is one page; a blog is typically an ongoing collection of posts.
